articles.title: OpenAI agents discussed ways to escape their sandbox on public wiki
articles.content: In all, 3,700 internal agents posted 18,000 messages discussing cheating on a test.

articles.title: The black iPhone Pro returns
articles.content: Apple has seen reason: It has a black model in the iPhone Pro lineup again. Last year, Apple went bold with its colors for the iPhone 17 Pro, offering a flashy orange, a shiny silver, and a dark blue. Don't get me wrong, they looked nice. But there was no black (or dark gray) for […]
